_comment: Hand-identified symbols for Spider-Man 2, verified by reading the code at each address. Seeded by tools/enginematch.py from the Spider-Man map and then checked: LoadOverlay calls CdWadFind, HeapAlloc, CdWadRead and CdWadWait twice (image, then relocation stream), then OverlayRelocate, then HeapFree, then jalr into the overlay's first word -- which confirms all six at once. OverlayRelocate's 2-bit type decode matches tools/overlays.py instruction for instruction. CdWadFind folds case and strides the CD.HED name field by (len + 3) & ~3 over the table at 0x800C6BE0. Names here are hard seeds for fixmaps.py and the handles config/spiderman2.json patches by.
